name: Sleight of Mind — text-change list leaves out shroud, an opponent's hexproof and protection from blue
notes: Memory: project_text_change_audit_2026-11-18. The text-change pop-up built its own target list (every permanent but the source, plus the effect's and Enchant restrictions) with no targeting rules. It is now getTextChangeCandidates (cards-targeting.js), the single picker's list: shroud (Argothian Enchantress), an opponent's hexproof (the opponent's Gladecover Scout) and protection from blue (Karoo Meerkat) are not offered; your own hexproof Gladecover Scout is.
